**Dishoom Shoreditch** is the best all-round choice: a lively Bombay-style café with consistently strong reviews. It's at **7 Boundary Street, E2 7JE**.[6][7][10]

Other excellent options:

- **Kricket Shoreditch** — best for modern, inventive Indian food; **36 Charlotte Road**.[2][3]
- **Gunpowder Spitalfields** — a good choice for creative small plates.[9]
- **Hoppers Shoreditch** — choose this for Sri Lankan and South Indian flavours.[8]
- **Sheba or Preem on Brick Lane** — better for traditional curry-house dining.[4]

annotations.title: The Best Indian Restaurants in Shoreditch London - Tripadvisor
